protocol.data_source: KQ2/CMP3 exact 4516 unit bank; raw segments are third _variable_pool return from anchor_spans

raw_bank_audit.normalization: raw pool uses run-01 q01/q99-normalized rows/actions; outliers may exceed [-1,1]

initial_invalid_run.cause: load_raw_bank unpacked _variable_pool return value 1 (physical DCT reconstruction) as raw; corrected to return value 3 (raw_pool)

raw_dct3.pair_sampling: uniform memory-unit pairs; self and same-task+episode pairs excluded

raw_dct8.pair_sampling: uniform memory-unit pairs; self and same-task+episode pairs excluded

raw_window10.pair_sampling: uniform memory-unit pairs; self and same-task+episode pairs excluded

protocol.tau_rule: memory-only different-episode pair-distance quantiles q25 and q50
protocol.dct_rule: DCT-II ortho divided by sqrt(unit length); retain lowest K=3 or 8; MSE over K×6
protocol.raw_window10_rule: first 10 raw frames; repeat final frame to length 10; MSE over 10×6
